_readme: Client-safe source for proposals/73def5c3fd6ef84a.html (Lani and Steve, Amalfi Coast 2027). This repo is public: no client emails or phones, no hotel rates, no internal notes in here. Excursion prices are the quoted options the clients choose between. Edit, then run: python3 tools/render_itinerary.py 73def5c3fd6ef84a

meta._build_help: draft shows the amber chips plus the dashed For Keith notes. final hides the For Keith notes. A chip disappears when its event status is set to confirmed.
meta.page_title: Lani & Steve on the Amalfi Coast
meta.hero_eyebrow: Private Itinerary · Prepared by Keith Pence, Suites With Keith
meta.hero_line: Santa Caterina, Amalfi · Il San Pietro, Positano · May 30 to June 4, 2027
meta.hero_alt: Il San Pietro di Positano on the cliffs above the sea
meta.hello: Lani and Steve, here is the whole trip in one place. Two nights at Santa Caterina in Amalfi, a day on the water down the coast, then three nights at Il San Pietro in Positano. Both hotels are booked. The transfers and days out are laid out as options, so tell me which ones you like and I will lock them in.
meta.how_to_read: Tap any day below to jump straight to it. Every address opens in Google Maps and every phone number is tap to call. Anything marked Your pick is waiting on your choice, and prices are per booking in euros, not per person.

hotels.name: Hotel Santa Caterina
hotels.label: Amalfi, 2 nights
hotels.maps_query: Hotel Santa Caterina, Via Mauro Comite 9, 84011 Amalfi, Italy
hotels.keith_todo: Swap in the room category (Front Sea View or Deluxe) from the booking. Lani asked which is better value, answer that in the email if not already.

hotels.label: Positano, 3 nights

hotels.room_details: Sunset view requested. Two reservations, one room: we are asking the hotel to link them so you never move
hotels.keith_todo: Email ISP to link 22710SH059403 and 22710SH059391 in one Premier room with a sunset view, under Steve Dildine. Points stay check in 2:00 PM, check out 11:00 AM.

days.title: Arrival in Amalfi
days.summary: Land in Naples, a private transfer down the coast to Santa Caterina, and an easy first evening at the hotel.

events.title: Private transfer, Naples Airport to Santa Caterina
events.details: Your driver meets you in arrivals. Pick one:
bullets: Mercedes E sedan with an English-speaking driver, EUR 295
Mercedes V-Class minivan with an English-speaking driver, EUR 350. More room for bags
Twin-engine helicopter with two pilots, car to and from the helipad included, EUR 7,900. Approximate, set at confirmation based on fuel and slot availability
events.keith_todo: Need their flight number and landing time into Naples.

events.title: Check in at Hotel Santa Caterina
events.maps_query: Hotel Santa Caterina, Via Mauro Comite 9, 84011 Amalfi, Italy
events.keith_note: I stayed here this October. Have your first drink on the terrace, the view straight down the coast to Amalfi town is the one you came for.

days.title: Up to Ravello
days.summary: A private walking tour of Ravello in the hills above Amalfi, then back down for an afternoon at the hotel's seaside lido.

events.title: Ravello, a 2-hour private walking tour
events.details: An English-speaking guide through the gardens and lanes of Ravello, with a Mercedes E sedan up from the hotel and back. EUR 790.
events.keith_todo: Pick a time with the supplier once they say yes. Morning is cooler and quieter in the gardens.

events.title: The rest of the day is yours
events.details: Santa Caterina's lido sits right on the water at the bottom of the hotel. Lunch by the sea and a swim is the easy call.

days.title: A day on the water, then Positano
days.summary: Check out of Santa Caterina and spend the day on a private boat along the coast, ending at Il San Pietro in Positano.

events.title: Private boat day and transfer, Amalfi to Il San Pietro
events.details: A full day on the water with a crew, ending at Il San Pietro. The price covers the boat, crew, fuel for the route, soft drinks and snacks on board. Pick a boat:
events.keith_todo: Attach the boat photos when sending. Confirm luggage goes by road from Santa Caterina to ISP, and the route and pickup time.

events.title: Check in at Il San Pietro di Positano, Premier Room
events.maps_query: Il San Pietro di Positano, Via Laurito 2, 84017 Positano, Italy
events.details: Your first night here is booked through me. Steve's points stay picks up tomorrow in the same room.

days.title: Path of the Gods
days.summary: A guided hike along the Sentiero degli Dei, high above Positano, with a car there and back.

events.title: Path of the Gods hike with an English-speaking guide
events.details: Round-trip transportation by Mercedes E sedan included. EUR 750. Wear proper walking shoes and bring water and sun protection, much of the trail is exposed.
events.keith_todo: Morning start is best before the heat. Lock the time with the supplier.

events.title: Your points reservation at Il San Pietro begins
events.details: Booked by Steve, June 2 to 4. Same room, nothing to do. This booking includes daily breakfast for two, a USD 100 property credit, a welcome amenity, and an upgrade, early check-in and late check-out if available.

days.title: A day at leisure
days.summary: Nothing scheduled. Il San Pietro is built for exactly this kind of day.

events.title: Ideas for the day
bullets: The hotel's beach club at the bottom of the cliff, reached by the elevator through the rock
Into Positano village for a wander and lunch
Sunset from your terrace before dinner
events.keith_todo: Offer a dinner booking at Zass, the hotel restaurant, for this night.

days.title: Departure
days.summary: Check out of Il San Pietro and on to Naples Airport, by road, by air, or the long way round by sea via Capri.

events.title: Check out of Il San Pietro
Private transfer, Il San Pietro to Naples Airport
bullets: Mercedes E sedan with an English-speaking driver, EUR 295
Mercedes V-Class minivan with an English-speaking driver, EUR 350
Add on a 2-hour walking tour of Pompeii on the way to either car, EUR 790
Twin-engine helicopter with two pilots, car to and from the helipad included, EUR 7,900. Approximate, set at confirmation
Private speedboat with a full-day tour around Capri, then a Mercedes from Naples port to the airport. Conam 58', EUR 7,650. Azimut Atlantis 55', EUR 7,350. Riva Dolceriva 48', EUR 10,450
events.keith_todo: Need the departing flight time, which rules options in or out (Capri day needs an evening flight). Azimut is quoted below the Conam here but above it on June 1, double check with the supplier.

good_to_know.title: How the options work
good_to_know.text: Every transfer and tour on this page is private, with an English-speaking driver or guide. Prices are in euros for the two of you. Tell me your picks and I will confirm each one here.

good_to_know.title: Helicopter pricing
good_to_know.text: The helicopter prices are approximate and are set at confirmation, based on fuel prices and slot availability.

good_to_know.title: Two bookings, one room at Il San Pietro
good_to_know.text: Your first night is booked through me and the next two are Steve's points stay. Both are a Premier Room. I am asking the hotel to link them so you stay put, and to note the sunset view.

good_to_know.title: Check-in and check-out
good_to_know.text: Il San Pietro check-in is 2:00 PM and check-out is 11:00 AM. If you would like an early check-in or a late check-out anywhere, tell me and I will ask.
